name: The Adventures of Dreambert and Bedsmith
original_name: The Adventures of Dreambert and Bedsmith
overview: When a vengeful darkness pulls Prince Dreambert, Bedsmith, and their allies into a deceptively beautiful world that feels eerily off, everything they know is about to unravel. With their pasts erased, trust is fragile, and every step could be their last– forcing them to face their fears, navigate hidden truths, and uncover who they truly are before the darkness unravels them completely.
